title: Ferry fares to rise by a quarter on the first of October
date: 2041-08-28
outlet: Quillon Reach Courier
author: Marisol Teague
---
The Pennet Ferry Authority confirmed this week that single fares will rise by a quarter
from the first of October. A monthly pass will stay at its current price until spring.

Readers who wrote in about the new timetable are thanked. The Courier regrets that last
week's issue gave the pier cafe's phone number with one digit missing.
